jira.boundaries.title: Boundaries
jira.boundary.authority_value: Approval is verified against Maestro's group mapping, not Jira permissions.
jira.boundary.note: This screen is reference documentation; it shows no live Jira content. Real gate decisions are made on the ticket page.
jira.boundary.progress_value: One global webhook; no per-project webhook or JQL maintenance.
jira.boundary.workflow_value: State transitions are never touched; progress is shown with labels and comments.
jira.check.authorised: Is the person authorised? Directory group membership is checked.
jira.check.edit_not_command: Editing a comment never counts as a command — /approve cannot be added later.
jira.check.idempotent: A repeat? The same command is never processed twice.
jira.check.no_extra_text: For commands without arguments the comment must contain nothing else: "/approve" inside a longer sentence is not an approval. In Turkish, negation comes at the end, which makes this rule a security requirement.
jira.check.recognised: Is the command recognised? A typo returns a polite warning.
jira.check.right_step: Is the flow at a step this command applies to?
jira.check.sod: Any SoD violation? The producer and the approver cannot be the same person.
jira.checks.subtitle: every command passes these in order
jira.checks.title: Validation chain

jira.commands.subtitle: all of them are written as ticket comments
jira.commands.title: Command set
jira.effect.ai_assign: Assigns an unmatched ticket to an application.
jira.effect.ai_explain: Explains the last change in plain language without altering the flow.
jira.effect.ai_handoff: The work is handed over to a human.
jira.effect.ai_start: Starts the flow in an opt-in project.
jira.effect.ai_takeover: The AI takes the work over from the human.
jira.effect.approve: Passes the gate and signs the decision.
jira.effect.cancel: Stops the flow and cleans up the sandbox and branch.
jira.effect.reject: Returns to the previous step and passes the reason to the agent.
jira.effect.status: The bot comments a status summary.
jira.intro.body: The analysis arrives as a comment, approval is given by comment, and progress is shown with labels. Jira workflow states are never touched (M102), and approval authority is verified against Maestro's group mapping, not Jira permissions.
jira.intro.title: Most people use Maestro from Jira
